itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Neither page is the county form - both are the filer's own spreadsheets, and neither prints a per-page SUBTOTAL. Each prints one unlabelled grand total in its last row: 11247.86 on the CONTRIBUTIONS sheet (rows = 11,247.86, EXACT) and 9841.84 on the EXPENDITURES sheet (rows = 9,841.84, EXACT). Both gate on those totals.
itemized.notes: Leslie Reberg, Recorder, June 2006 AMENDMENT. Two Excel-style printouts, not the county grid; the sheet titles 'CONTRIBUTIONS' and 'EXPENDITURES' are set as ROTATED cell text (an Excel formatting choice), which makes the page look landscape at a glance - the tables themselves read normally and were NOT rotated. The Address column is COUNTY-REDACTED with a solid black bar, so donor_city/donor_state are blank as REDACTED. ELEVEN ROWS APPEAR ON BOTH SHEETS BY DESIGN: the six candidate LOAN rows and the five IN-KIND rows are each recorded once as a contribution and once as the matching expenditure (identical date, party and amount), which is why the two sides overlap by 2,347.86; both are transcribed, and the rightmost column's 'Loan' / 'In-Kind' / 'CASH' marks are carried in each row's note. in_kind is set TRUE on the five In-Kind rows of each side; the six Loan rows are NOT flagged in_kind. GEOMETRY IS OMITTED ON THIS FILING ON PURPOSE: the two spreadsheets' ruled grids defeated every row-boundary detector I tried and the two sheets do not share a layout, so any row band I emitted would have been a guess - per the contract a wrong pointer is worse than none. Everything else on the filing is fully transcribed and both sides gate exactly. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: date, name and amount counts agree per sheet (35 and 24); the eleven loan/in-kind rows match one-for-one across the two sheets on date AND amount, which is a strong independent alignment check; both sheets gate exactly. No shift found.
